hypotheses.B0_edge_partition_recomposes: The Layer-8 head-by-source-relation edge partition and its mapped Layer-9 value contributions recompose to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.B1_direct_cue_read_is_material: Direct reads from the swapped cue account for at least 25% of the finite Layer-8-attention-only spelling shift in every fold/split cell.
hypotheses.B2_boundary_self_is_not_the_source: Boundary-self reads account for less than 25% of the finite Layer-8-attention-only spelling shift in every cell.
hypotheses.B3_one_head_is_not_the_whole_builder: No individual Layer-8 head accounts for more than 75% of the attention-component local projection in any cell.
hypotheses.B4_builder_head_identity_replicates: The strongest Layer-8 head by local projection on split 0 is also strongest on split 1 for at least two of three spelling-pair folds.
hypotheses.B5_direct_two_hop_route_is_supported: B0, B1, B2, and B4 all hold.
hypotheses.B6_full_attention_component_is_causal: The assembled Layer-8 attention contribution shifts the disjoint spelling contrast correctly in at least 80% of examples in every cell.
